clips.speaker: Cousin Lender
clips.title: KJI首席：中国AI发展确定性更高，互联网巨头将成最终赢家
title_lines: 互联网巨头将成最终赢家

subtitles.en: So, you can argue that the visibility and the certainty of the China AI development model is actually much higher.
subtitles.zh: 可以说，中国AI发展模式的可见性和确定性实际上更高。

subtitles.en: And just because of the short term market and the performance, I don't think the Chinese will be changing this business model.
subtitles.zh: 仅仅因为短期市场和表现，我认为中国不会改变这种商业模式。

subtitles.en: So, in terms of the beneficiaries then, I mean, you said you still favor some of these downstream AI names. Right now, what are going to be those potential winners?
subtitles.zh: 那么关于受益者，您说您仍然看好一些下游AI公司。现在哪些会是潜在赢家？

subtitles.en: No, I think we're similar to the last boom of the internet bubble, who developed internet. Some may know, some forget, but the company is not there, who make most of the money from internet.
subtitles.zh: 我认为类似上一次互联网泡沫，那些开发互联网的公司，有些知名有些已被遗忘，但真正从互联网赚到最多钱的不是它们。

subtitles.en: Those who use the best use of internet make the most money out of that.
subtitles.zh: 那些最好地利用互联网的公司赚到了最多的钱。

subtitles.en: I think similar in China, a lot of big internet giants, they have a huge ecosystem and they are incorporating the AI model into the existing business. That will prove them to be the ultimate winner in this AI race.
subtitles.zh: 类似地，中国很多大型互联网巨头拥有庞大生态系统，正在将AI模型融入现有业务。这将证明它们是这场AI竞赛的最终赢家。

clips.speaker_context: CIO of KJI International Wealth Management

clips.speaker: Cousin Lender
clips.title: KJI首席：香港市场短期风险与长期催化剂并存
title_lines: 香港市场短期风险与长期催化剂

subtitles.en: Aside from AI, I wonder what is your assessment of risk per se in the back half of the year? I mean, rear-watching and trying to decipher what the Fed is going to do.
subtitles.zh: 除了AI，您对下半年风险本身的评估是什么？我的意思是，关注美联储动向并试图解读其意图。

subtitles.en: So, RAGE strategy is on the cards, but aside from that, also trade negotiations between the US and China, how that might pick up? How are you positioning on advising clients?
subtitles.zh: 所以RAGE策略有可能，但除此之外，中美贸易谈判也可能升温。您如何为客户定位？

subtitles.en: Yeah, I think I would like to divide that question into two parts. I think in terms of the short-term risk, the one and the largest risk is that because of the underperformance of the Hong Kong China market,
subtitles.zh: 我想把这个问题分为两部分。短期风险方面，最大的风险是香港及内地市场表现不佳，

subtitles.en: and that potentially, and together on the back job that the rest of Asia is doing quite well, what we are afraid would be a richer cycle where capital starts to flow out of Hong Kong China,
subtitles.zh: 加上亚洲其他地区表现良好，我们担心会出现一个恶性循环，资金开始流出香港和内地，

subtitles.en: and then that richer cycle just keeps the market moving down, just like post-COVID. We have got a couple of years where investors try to avoid the market.
subtitles.zh: 这个恶性循环导致市场持续下跌，就像疫情后那样。有几年投资者试图避开这个市场。

subtitles.en: But I think this time there could be two main difference. One is on the development side. Ever since China launched the deep sleep model, I think the development of the technology and the model just keeps going on.
subtitles.zh: 但我认为这次有两个主要不同。一是发展方面。自从中国推出DeepSeek模型，技术和模型的发展一直在持续。

subtitles.en: I think that is one main catalyst for the market. We don't know when, but as far as the establishment of that new technology breakthrough, that will be a big catalyst for the market.
subtitles.zh: 我认为这是市场的一个主要催化剂。我们不知道何时，但一旦这项新技术突破确立，将成为市场的重大催化剂。

subtitles.en: And therefore, I think that will prevent money from sorting long-term on the market. Secondly, I think very different from a couple of years back,
subtitles.zh: 因此，我认为这将阻止资金长期远离市场。其次，与几年前非常不同，

subtitles.en: that is huge amount of IPO into the market, and that will cap the global investor focus into the Hong Kong China market, although short-term there's neck of catalysts.
subtitles.zh: 大量IPO进入市场，这将吸引全球投资者关注香港和内地市场，尽管短期催化剂不足。

clips.speaker_context: CIO of KJI International Wealth Management

clips.speaker: Cousin Lender
clips.title: KJI首席：香港楼市复苏更坚实，人口增长驱动真实需求
title_lines: 人口增长驱动真实需求

subtitles.en: And talking about Hong Kong property, I mean part of that whole IPO is really kind of driving a lot of the real estate market to come back. How real is it this recovery you think this time around?
subtitles.zh: 谈到香港房地产，IPO热潮也在推动楼市回暖。您认为这次复苏有多真实？

subtitles.en: I think this is much more than last 15 years when I look at the Hong Kong oil market. I think this time around there's not different by liquidity. There was not different by speculation.
subtitles.zh: 我认为这比过去15年看到的任何一次都更坚实。这次不是由流动性驱动，也不是由投机驱动。

subtitles.en: There was purely driven by population in Hong Kong increasing, and there is demand for housing.
subtitles.zh: 纯粹是由香港人口增长和住房需求驱动的。

subtitles.en: And that drive the rent to yield increased to surpass the mortgage rate. I think that looks to be much more solid than all the past upcycle I have seen.
subtitles.zh: 这推动租金收益率超过抵押贷款利率。我认为这看起来比我见过的所有过去上升周期都更坚实。

clips.speaker_context: CIO of KJI International Wealth Management
